authenticity_review:
The image demonstrates exceptional structural integrity for a complex multi-object generation. All five guitars maintain correct Stratocaster geometry, functional components (pickups, bridges, knobs, tuning pegs), and physically consistent lighting/shadows. The 'spotted' texture, while stylistically flat, adheres well to the body contours without significant warping. 

However, two specific artifacts prevent a perfect score:
1. Text Gibberish: Headstock logos are illegible scribbles mimicking text shape but lacking semantic content (Severity 2).
2. Texture Uniformity: The spot patterns appear slightly projected/flat on the curved glossy surfaces, lacking the subtle distortion/reflection variance of real paint (Severity 1).

These are minor defects in an otherwise highly realistic render. The authenticity score reflects high fidelity with penalization for these specific AI tells.
key_defects: Headstock logos are illegible gibberish/scribbles rather than coherent brand text.
Spotted texture appears somewhat flat/projected on curved surfaces, lacking realistic gloss variation.
